evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this would take let's say fifteen to twenty minutes of your time' but does not wait for customer affirmation before pressing ahead; customer is still uncertain about email/profile and rep pivots to 'general pricing' without clear consent framing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (James Walker) and moving date (end of October) confirmed; route mentioned ('a couple of miles') and apartment stated; no specific move date pinned, no city-to-city route fully captured, bedroom count later mentioned (one bedroom) but not all four systematically asked upfront.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into profile creation and hourly rate explanation without asking 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Apartment confirmed, one bedroom mentioned, full packing needed. No systematic probing on floors, walking distance, additional rooms, special considerations, or additional stops — minimal gathering.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes: 'for packing, sir. We charge the same hourly rate. Now the only addition to the hourly rate will be the packing materials.' Customer confirms 'Full pack. Okay.'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: No box count question or overflow check offered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Range given ($1,300 to $1,500 for pack-and-move) but not personalized to customer's specific concerns or prep level — generic one-bedroom estimate with no tie to what the customer raised.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Hourly rate ($208–$230 for two movers) disclosed; materials fee ($189) mentioned. Missing: trip fee, overnight fee, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute-increment commitment, and 'not a guess' framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep gives estimate and customer says 'Okay, sounds good' without rep asking 'does that feel fair?' and pausing.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Alright, any more questions before I let you go?' — a throwaway yes/no question, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' prompt.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Customer volunteers 'put me on, on, on the book somewhere before' and rep responds with 'just give us a call once you're ready to book' — no explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' from the rep.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking. Customer is told to call back when ready; no date, phone, arrival window, crew size, or addresses confirmed. No crew notes left about customer's concerns.

top_strength: Rep successfully gathered that the customer needs full packing services and offered pricing on an uncommon scenario (no email provided), maintaining composure and flexibility when the standard profile-creation path was blocked.
coaching_note: Skipped the entire Section 2 discovery of customer's concerns and priorities — no 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' — jumping straight into features and pricing, which left no foundation for a personalized pitch and missed the chance to address underlying anxieties.
